verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents token-based payment requests alongside client-side public keys, and it offers hosted and low-code options (Hosted Payment Page, Flow components, Mobile SDK). These are marketed as avoiding 'confusing compliance' and helping you 'stay compliant', which implies card data is captured off the merchant's servers. However, the evidence never explicitly says card data never touches merchant servers or names a reduced PCI DSS scope such as SAQ A. Missing for 10: an explicit PCI DSS scope-reduction statement (e.g., SAQ A eligibility), documentation of the client-side tokenization flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
